header.title: API Key Vault
header.subtitle: Secure custody for Hyperliquid trading credentials and AI model inference keys — plaintext never leaves the vault

locked.title: Your encrypted credential vault is locked
locked.desc1: You are not signed in. Under Heimdall's security architecture, all exchange private keys (Hyperliquid / Binance / OKX) and LLM API keys are protected with hardware-grade AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption and isolated one-to-one by your Web3 wallet address.
locked.desc2: Unauthorized cross-tenant lookup or display of credentials is strictly prohibited. Connect your Web3 wallet and sign to verify your identity to unlock your private vault.

tabs.probeStatus: Self-check probes on standby: 4 connections OK

banner.hlBody: Never enter the seed phrase or private key of a main wallet holding your assets! Instead, create a dedicated agent private key under "API Agents" on the Hyperliquid website that can only open and close positions, keeping your main assets fully isolated from the trading environment.
banner.llmBody: Claude 3.5 Sonnet handles the core long/short debate and win-rate assessment, while DeepSeek V3 / R1 rapidly scans news and on-chain anomalies — combining strong reasoning with millisecond-level response.
